deployments_detail.use: "盐湖产业AI创新应用联合实验室" (w/ China Telecom & Huawei); dual-driven intelligent models (process + AI); first centrifuge ore-output AI soft-measurement model in production; "产业大脑+未来工厂"

AI predictive soft-sensor model for the reverse-flotation/cold-crystallization KCl line, predicting centrifuge underflow (下矿量) where physical instruments fail on solid-liquid mixtures; shifted control from 'experience-driven' to 'AI prediction'. First such model at a Chinese potash producer. [Self-developed (Qinghai Salt Lake Potash), on Qinghai green-computing infrastructure]
deployments_detail.value: Process-unit stability raised from 78% to 93%; direct economic benefit >20M yuan/year; equipment maintenance cost cut 6M yuan/year; centrifuge underflow error kept <3%

deployments_detail.use: Flotation-process AI models predicting real-time concentration, foam condition and reagent dosing, and automatically detecting/correcting process deviations, replacing manual adjustments previously needed every 1-2 hours. [Self-developed (Qinghai Salt Lake Potash)]

Data-driven smart factory: 'Million-tonne reverse-flotation/cold-crystallization KCl production unit data-driven smart factory' recognized as an Advanced-level Smart Factory in China Minmetals' 2026 list; full-chain digital/intelligent transformation of potash manufacturing. [Qinghai Salt Lake Potash (China Minmetals group)]

'5G + Smart Salt Lake' project enabling unmanned/remote-controlled salt-mining vessels: HD cameras stream footage over 5G to the cloud for image-recognition analysis of worker behavior and environment (safety warning), with remote PLC vessel control. [China Mobile Qinghai + ZTE (中兴通讯)]

Patent 'Autonomous-driving control method and system for salt-lake salt-mining vessels' (CN122363213A): multi-source environmental perception, obstacle detection (salt ridges, embankments, soft mud, other vessels), intelligent path-planning and obstacle-avoidance for industrial-grade unmanned operation. [Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Co. (in-house)]

Established a 'Salt Lake Industry AI Innovation Application Joint Lab' and is exploring cooperation with Huawei to apply AI and robotics to intelligent upgrading of salt-lake lithium-extraction processes. [Huawei (exploration)]

Strategic cooperation with Siemens for a digital factory on the new lithium-carbonate project, using Siemens process-modeling/simulation software (COMOS, gPROMS, SIMIT, SiePA) and combined hardware-software digital-factory solutions plus digital-delivery and talent programs. [Siemens]

'Process mechanism + AI algorithm' dual-driven models across multiple process units (crystallization, slurry washing, dust-removal auto-cleaning) plus predictive equipment monitoring, tracking 128 critical parameters in real time (the 'intelligent brain' on the million-tonne line). [Self-developed (Qinghai Salt Lake Potash)]
deployments_detail.value: 128 critical parameters monitored in real time

deployments_detail.use: Potash division 'data-driven salt-lake cloud industry' project selected as a national finalist in the 2025 national 'Data Element x' competition (智能制造 track), applying data-driven analytics to potash production scenarios. [Qinghai Salt Lake Potash branch (钾肥分公司)]

Video-analytics safety monitoring of salt-lake worksites: cloud image-recognition of on-site personnel actions and environmental conditions for real-time early warning, monitoring coverage and post-incident evidence collection (part of the 5G smart-lake buildout). [China Mobile Qinghai + ZTE]
